vikisozluk_etimolojiler.metin: From Aramaic אַשְׁלָא (ʾašlā, “rope”) (Classical Syriac ܐܻܝܫܠܴܐ (ʾīšlā, “rope”)), in Imperial Aramaic 𐡀𐡔𐡋 (ʾšl, “a surface measure”), from Akkadian 𒌑𒌃 (^ÚNINNI₅ /⁠ašlu⁠/, “rush; tow-rope; measuring rope; a linear measure of about 60 meters; a surface measure”). Doublet of أَسَل (ʔasal, “long and slender twigs; rush; spear”).
See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
